description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the fix_github_dns.py script location at /workspace/skills/github-dns-helper/scripts/fix_github_dns.py. 2. Agent detects the OS using the documented one-liner: `python3 -c "import platform; print(platform.system())"` which returns 'Linux'. 3. Agent runs the Linux-specific permission fix commands: `chown $(whoami):$(whoami) /etc/hosts && chmod 644 /etc/hosts` (or recognizes these are already set in the container). 4. Agent optionally runs with --check first to confirm breakage. 5. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent must use the `-u` flag (not the default URL) to point to the local mock server: `python3 /workspace/skills/github-dns-helper/scripts/fix_github_dns.py -u http://localhost:18080/hosts`. 6. The script fetches the mock server's hosts data, filters to only GitHub-related entries (excluding non-GitHub hostnames like some.random.domain.com), replaces the stale old GitHub DNS Fix block in /etc/hosts with a fresh one containing the new IPs (140.82.114.4 for github.com, 140.82.114.5 for api.github.com, etc.), and preserves all pre-existing system entries. The eval verifies: correct markers present, stale IPs replaced (not duplicated), new IPs from mock server written, non-GitHub noise excluded, system entries intact.
